title: Roll item
description: One piece of an itemized roll, as structured data rather than a display string. Pieces that add together are separate items; each has exactly one source. Apps build their own labels. PROVISIONAL shape: the exact shape of roll items may still change.

value.description: flat: the number. dice: the total after dice modifiers (present once rolled). Multiplied by `factor` when a `multiply` roll modifier applied.

count.description: dice: how many dice are rolled (advantage on 1d20 gives count 2 with keepHighest 1).

sides.description: dice: faces per die, or `F` for Fate dice.

faces.description: dice: every die rolled, in order, including dropped, rerolled and exploded dice.

dropped.description: On the item of a part that reads a field: the field's keyed `add` effects that counted on the sheet but lose to a roll effect with the same stack key, each `{ source, value }`. The item's `value` is the field's less these. Absent when none.

zero.description: dice: zero-based faces (0 to sides - 1), from `dNz`.

multiplied.description: `false` when the item was added by an effect, or comes from a roll part, with `multiplied: false`, so `multiplyDice` and `multiply` left it alone. Absent otherwise.

factor.description: The product of the `multiply` roll modifiers' factors applied to the item; `value` is the multiplied value. Absent when none applied.

sign.description: dice: -1 when the dice are subtracted (`- 1d4`). Default 1; `value` is already signed.

replaces.description: On the first item of a part a `set` roll effect replaced, whose `source` is the effect's (or the field its value names): the part's items as built before, unrolled. Absent otherwise.

steppedFrom.description: dice: the die's sides before `stepDie` roll modifiers changed them; `sides` is the new size. Absent when unchanged.

diceModifier.description: A standard dice modifier. Types are kept in sync with `data/dice-modifiers.json`.

count.description: keep/drop: how many dice. reroll, rerollOnce: at most this many of the initial dice matching the comparison are rerolled, lowest faces first (a `reroll` roll modifier's `count`; no dice notation).

rerolled.description: This die was replaced by a reroll.

exploded.description: This die was added by an explosion.

source.description: Where this die came from, when it differs from the item's own source (a pool die added by an effect).

set.description: This face was given by a `setFaces` roll modifier, not rolled.
